plan.title: Save eRFX Draft with Participants and T&C

steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Provide the required project title so the draft can be saved and reopened.
Keep the default single Auction stage for the eRFX project.
Apply a pricing template before adding the item.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Add two QA vendors as the draft participants.

args.goal: add one T&C clause to the event and stop on the create screen showing the added clause

steps.note: Add the T&C clause, which has no dedicated catalog action.
Record the visible participant section before saving for comparison after reopening.
Record the visible Terms & Conditions section before saving.
Save the configured event as a draft.
Confirm that saving the draft did not show an application error.
Return to the events list to locate the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab where the saved event should appear.
Assert that this plan's newly saved event appears in Drafts.
Assert that the event is labeled Draft in the list.
Reopen this plan's draft on its create screen.
Compare the reopened participant section with its pre-save content.
Compare the reopened Terms & Conditions section with its pre-save content.
